info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Payment By Param1-spec
info.description: The Payment Retrieval API allows users to fetch payment details based on a specific parameter. This endpoint is primarily used to obtain information about transactions, enabling business analysts and financial teams to access transaction history effortlessly. Users can specify a unique identifier to retrieve relevant payment data, enhancing transparency and facilitating financial oversight. Ideal for applications requiring seamless integration with banking operations, this API streamlines access to critical payment information for reporting and analysis purposes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information about a specific payment rail operation identified by its unique ID (PAY-300045).

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of the payment rail operation identified by PAY-300045. It requires specific parameters to be provided in JSON format to ensure a successful operation retrieval.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned the expected data.

GetPaymentByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for GET operations on payment rail with ID PAY-300045.

instructedAmount.description: The amount of money that has been instructed for the payment.

requestedExecutionDate.description: The date when the payment is requested to be executed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update of the record.

metadata.description: Meta information regarding the payment transaction.

GetPaymentByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response for payment rail operations.

amount.description: The monetary amount for the payment.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

InstructedAmount.description: Schema representing the instructed amount for a payment.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographical region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Schema representing metadata information related to the payment.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request. This header helps in tracking and logging the specific endpoint used during the API call.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that processed the request. This header provides context regarding the application responsible for handling the API call.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes a Bearer authentication method in which a client must provide a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header of their requests. The server verifies the token to authenticate the user and authorize access to protected resources.
